visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Build the Word Piece by Piece
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Nested if/else blocks and two flags decide the output. Print Fizz and Buzz separately and print the number only when nothing was printed. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: FizzBuzz is just Fizz followed by Buzz, so no combined case is needed. Adding a new rule such as Bazz for 7 is one more if, instead of doubling the number of branches.
